cases.source_title: I changed my mind about agent skills
cases.content: The speaker used to recommend preloading every available skill. After comparing agents with a global skill bundle against agents given one tool only when a concrete failure appeared, the larger bundle reduced task accuracy. The speaker now recommends adding skills only in response to a demonstrated need.
